items.claim: Manuel Sosa lacks technical polish at this point in his career.
items.quote: I don't think they're necessarily the most technical at this point in time.

items.claim: Manuel Sosa has not proven that he can effectively wrestle and grapple.
items.quote: until he can prove to me that the man can actually wrestle and grapple a bit, I'm going to be a little bit concerned for Manuel Sosa

items.claim: Richie Miranda is defensively vulnerable and his striking defense is not particularly good.
items.quote: I think on the feet, he's very defen- defensively vulnerable. I think his striking defense is not particularly good

items.claim: Richie Miranda has never been knocked out in his career.
items.quote: we've never seen him knocked out. We haven't really seen his chin be a real problem in the past.

items.claim: Richie Miranda is predominantly a striker who is comfortable standing and trading.
items.quote: the man is more than comfortable to just stand and trade on the feet. He likes to box.
